title: Estate Review Session Weekly Review Time Trend
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=estate:review review_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(review_minutes) as avg_duration, max(review_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst review time for estate review session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture review_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average review time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether estate review session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
